studyArea.label: Atacama bounded climate evidence transect (demonstration v2)

studyAreaLimitations: This four-cell study area is a reproducible pipeline demonstration, not a validated discovery or claim that candidates are Mars analogs.
Atacama is used because the profile addresses measured thermal and meteorological stressors in an extreme environment; this does not make the environment equivalent to Mars.

A 75 km exclusion expanded by grid-cell half-diagonal masks cells near point-coordinate references. Coordinate-free region references remain explicitly unmasked; masking does not establish geological independence.
Cell centers are sampling coordinates for coarse grid cells, not precise field locations. Longitude and latitude spacing are angular degrees, so cell dimensions vary by latitude.

The selected profile requires six NASA POWER-supported climate factors. Provider support does not guarantee retrieval success; mission requirements remain unmet whenever evidence is missing, failed, or invalid.
Copernicus GLO-30 is a digital surface model point sample. GLiM is generalized mapped lithology. Neither provides the unavailable quantitative operational factors in this mission profile.

referenceMasking.rule: Reference point within configured distance after conservative grid-cell half-diagonal expansion; coordinate-free references are unmasked.
